## Publication Information

**Date:** 1857

**Imprint:** <i>MP</i> (February -June 1857)

**Notes:** Whoever the author of this tale was, he or she was evidently unknown to CMY and her associates, because the editor of <i>MP</i> advertised for his or her address in the February 1857 issue which carried the first instalment.
